item.title: River Run + Cold Plunge (with Sauna!) — Tue Sep 1, 3:00 PM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description: Trade your Saturday afternoon for a tidal adventure on the Petaluma River. Launching from downtown Petaluma, this guided Downriver Run takes you six scenic miles through wide-open wetlands and peaceful river landscapes in easy-to-use Hobie pedal kayaks. From 3–5 pm, ride the outgoing tide from The Floathouse Petaluma to Lakeville Landing Marina, where the experience can continue with an optional discounted sauna + cold plunge session at Sundrop Sauna from 5–6:30 pm. Warm up in the sauna, cool down with a plunge, and relax riverside in the golden evening light. Want to make it a floating picnic party? Add a Bella Box from La Bella Charcuterie, with omnivore, vegetarian, and vegan options available. This is Sonoma County river culture at its finest: movement, nature, community, wellness, and good vibes — all in one unforgettable afternoon. item.title: Nature Hike at Vallejo Swett-Ranches — Sat Sep 5, 9:00 AM — King-Swett Ranches
item.description:
Come explore the hills between Fairfield, Benicia, and Vallejo. Solano Land Trust docents will guide you through this area, known as the King-Swett Ranches. Docents will share insights about the birds and other wildlife that call this area home, and give you a great workout!
Hike level: Moderate to Moderately Strenuous. Please note: Vallejo Swett is an undeveloped property with no formal trails. This is a rugged & an off trail hike. Participants could be climbing or going under fences, and tree branches. Docents also can go up & along of steep and clumpy ground mountain sides.
\*Please note, cancellation of the hike may occur due to County Fire Danger Warnings and closures of open spaces and parks. Once registered, you will receive any updates should this ever happen.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

When: Tours start at 1pm every first and third Saturday of the month, April through October. Where: Tours start and end at the OAEC Nursery. 15290 Coleman Valley Rd, Occidental, CA 95465. Upper Driveway. Important Information: No registration required—just show up! Please use the second driveway and park in the upper lot near the greenhouses. The tour route includes steep hills and unpaved dirt and gravel paths. Sturdy shoes, a brimmed hat, and weather-appropriate layers are recommended. item.description: BODY PRAYER IS A FACILITATED EVENT DEVOTED TO INQUIRY INTO EMBODIED CONSCIOUSNESS THROUGH MOVEMENT. This class is offered every Sunday morning, and led by Zuza Engler or another teacher. It is usually attended by a vibrant & diverse bunch of welcoming and friendly people, some of whom have practiced Soul Motion® for years, while some ~ never before. What to expect Guidance and structure are part of every week’s class as we travel across the four landscapes of Soul Motion®: Dance Infinite (prayer space) Dance Community (ensemble) Dance Communion (duet) Dance Intimate (solo) Practices, structures, and points of view are offered to facilitate the journey. Participants are invited to travel across all landscapes, not just their favorite one: dancing by oneself, in duet, in ensemble with several people and eventually the whole room, or witnessing in stillness the beauty of another’s or of everyone’s dance. item.title: Monday Jazz Jam — Mon Sep 7, 7:00 PM — Empress Marquee Club
item.description:
Bring your instrument, bring your friends, and settle in for a night of live jazz at the Empress Marquee Club. Monday Jazz Jam is a welcoming, musician-friendly evening where players can sit in, listeners can enjoy a relaxed club atmosphere, and the music moves naturally from swinging standards to blues, ballads, Latin grooves, and spontaneous improvisation.
Together, they’ll anchor the night with taste, experience, and musical flexibility, giving guest musicians a strong foundation to step up and join the jam. Whether you’re a horn player, vocalist, guitarist, percussionist, bassist, pianist, or simply a jazz lover, this is a night built around community, creativity, and live interaction.
Musicians play free and get dinner, making this one of Vallejo’s most inviting weekly gatherings for working players, students, seasoned improvisers, and music fans alike.
The jam runs from 7 PM to 10 PM, with doors and dinner beginning at 6 PM.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
